verdict.rationale: QuickBooks documents an 'Intuit Intelligence' chat feature explicitly letting users type natural-language requests to create invoices, run payroll, generate reports, and get financial answers, and Intuit also ships an official MCP server exposing 145 QBO API tools for agentic/AI use. However, all of this is vendor-sourced claims and developer tooling with no independent/community validation of natural-language command reliability, and general community feedback flags quality and reliability concerns with the broader product.
